$comment: The Astro Study test (TASK-0013): which part of the chart each area's questions are written from, in order of preference, and the question shown above its three statements. Anchors: a planet or point as named in the chart data, an angle (ASC, MC), or a house (H1 to H12). Angles and houses need a birth time; a quiz never uses the same anchor twice. Selection configuration only: the meaning comes from the knowledge base, through the reading pipeline.
